units.source_text: 有时，我几个小时坐在草地上，观察着鸡蚁搬运细红上去造窝的情形。

en.t: At times, I would sit on the grass for hours, watching the ants carry fine red soil up to build their nest.

units.source_text: 并非蚂蚁引起我的兴趣。

en.t: It was not the ants that interested me.

units.source_text: 有时，我长时间地呆望着学校后面的工厂的烟囱冒出的缕缕轻烟。

en.t: At times, I would stare for a long while at the wisps of pale smoke rising from the chimney of the factory behind the school.

units.source_text: 也并非烟云引起我的兴趣……

en.t: Nor was it the smoke or clouds that interested me...

units.source_text: 我觉得我全然地，甚至连生命都沉浸在自己的存在中。

en.t: I felt that I was wholly immersed in my own existence, even down to my very life.

units.source_text: 外界处处都是忽而冰冷，忽而炎热。

en.t: Everywhere, the outside world was now icy cold, now burning hot.
Yes, how should I put it?

units.source_text: 外界时而呈现斑驳，时而又呈现条纹状。

en.t: The outside world would appear mottled at one moment, then striped at another.

units.source_text: 自己的内在和外界不规则地缓慢地轮流转化，

en.t: My own inner self and the outside world slowly and irregularly took turns transforming into one another,

units.source_text: 四周无意义的风景映在我的眼帘里，

en.t: the meaningless scenery around me was reflected before my eyes,

units.source_text: 风景闯入了我的内心，而且没有闯入的部分在彼方活泼地闪烁着。

en.t: the scenery forced its way into my heart, while the parts that did not enter shimmered vividly over there beyond me.

units.source_text: 这闪烁着的东西，有时是工厂的旗帜，

en.t: That shimmering thing was sometimes the factory flag,

units.source_text: 有时是土墙上的微不足道的污点，

en.t: sometimes a trivial stain on the earthen wall,

units.source_text: 有时又是被抛弃在草丛中的一只旧木屣。

en.t: and sometimes an old wooden clog abandoned in the grass.

units.source_text: 所有这些东西，都是一瞬间在我心中产生，

en.t: All these things would arise in my heart in an instant,

units.source_text: 又一瞬间在我心中消失。

en.t: and in another instant disappear from it.

units.source_text: 可以说，这是没有形成所有形态的思想吧……

en.t: One might say that these were thoughts that had not yet taken on any definite form...

units.source_text: 我觉得重要的事物总是与微不足道的事物联系在一起，

en.t: I felt that important things were always linked to trivial things,

units.source_text: 今天报上刊登的欧洲政治事件，似乎同眼前的旧木屣有着不可分割的联系。

en.t: and that the European political events printed in today's newspaper seemed inseparably connected with the old wooden clog before my eyes.
